verdict.rationale: Pylon's Runbooks feature explicitly lets ops leads write natural-language, step-by-step instructions ('manuals') for agents to follow on specific scenarios, and Skills/rubrics add reusable, enforceable workflow logic, closely matching the SOP/deterministic-branching story. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of conditional/branching logic syntax within runbooks (evidence shows natural-language instructions but not a formal branching/decision-tree construct) and no independent/hands-on validation of runbook determinism.
